overview: Glassblower’s Court is home to Katta’s glass artisans, producing blown‑glass goods, ceremonial vessels, arcane lenses, and civic ornaments.
history: Founded to centralize furnace‑based craft and blown‑glass artistry.
Guild oversight ensured safe furnace operation and glazing standards.
The district expanded to support Ceramics Terrace and Artisan Row.
hooks: A Senate ritual requires urgently crafted ceremonial glass vessels.
A furnace overheats, threatening a chain reaction.
A shipment of rare sand goes missing from the storage yard.
Arcane blowpipes malfunction across the district.
